summary: Slug lowercases the input, keeps Unicode letters and digits, and joins runs with single hyphens, with no leading or trailing hyphens. TestSlug covers both criterion inputs plus the empty string and repeated separators. No defects found.

criteria.evidence: slug.go: non-letter/digit runs become one hyphen only between kept runs; TestSlug maps "Red Shoes (Size 9)" to "red-shoes-size-9"; evidence/criterion-1.jsonl.
Leading separators are skipped because b.Len() == 0, trailing ones are never written, and unicode.IsLetter keeps 'é'; TestSlug maps "  --Café--  " to "café"; evidence/criterion-2.jsonl.
